description: This is a unit test class for the WorkWeekAPI, testing various API endpoint behaviors such as fetching, updating, and validation of work week data within the leave module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: WorkWeekAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the WorkWeekAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM leave module.

methods.name: testGetWorkWeekService
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the WorkWeekService instance through the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single WorkWeek by ID and verifies normalized output.

methods.name: testGetOneWithIndexedModel
methods.description: Tests fetching a WorkWeek with model indexing, verifying array normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the rules for the getOne API call with valid parameters.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOneWithModel
methods.description: Validates the rules for getOne API call without model parameter.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a WorkWeek and checks the updated normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the rules for the update API call with valid parameters.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures the validation rules for delete throw a not implemented exception.
